cues.text: Sometimes a garment goes home with the wrong customer. It happens. Here is how to stay calm, figure it out, and fix it.
One. Say sorry and stay calm. Never argue or blame. Tell the customer we will fix it.
Two. Look at the tag on the wrong garment. The tag number tells you who it really belongs to.
Three. Type that tag number into the Ticket List search box.
Four. Open the ticket with Detail. Check the pieces and colors to be sure this is the right owner.
Five. Now look for the first customer’s own garment. It is usually still here, on the rack near the other order, often with a similar number or color.
Six. Tell a manager what happened, before anyone calls or drives anywhere.
In Ticket List, type the tag number. The ticket shows the real owner, what the order looks like, and where it was supposed to be.
If a ticket was marked picked up or delivered by mistake, find it in Ticket List and press Backtrack. Type the reason, like gave to the wrong customer.
Backtrack puts the ticket back in cleaning, so you can mark it ready and assign the rack again.
Add a note on the customer profile, so everyone knows what happened.
Then the manager arranges the swap: the customer comes back, or our driver brings the right garment and picks up the wrong one.
To stop it from happening: at pickup, check the name, the ticket number, and the tag number on every piece.
Count the pieces together with the customer, and scan the barcode instead of guessing.
